messages:
Priya Shah: FYI AcmePay is seeing a flood of 502/504s against hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. They timeout after 10s and report many failed requests. Raising for triage. Request ids redacted.
Jamal Rivera: On it. Do we have SLO alerts firing?
Priya Shah: Yes — infra/slo-prod error-rate alert fired at 09:15 (spike to ~18% over 5m). Paging oncall.
Maya Chen: @here I'm oncall. Initial glance: gateway logs show upstream read timeouts and 504s. Checking autoscaler and model-server readiness.
OpsBot: keda-controller: scaledobject/ro-inference-pool evaluated but no scale (activationThreshold not reached) at 09:13 UTC.
Gabe Lin: Looking at the scaledObject: activationThreshold is 120. Our queue metric peaked around 65-80 for this tenant. That annotation changed in last deploy — looks like we over-tuned it.
Jamal Rivera: Is there also an HPA in the loop? Could minReplicas or cooldown be conflicting with KEDA behavior?
Victor Ng: HPA exists: minReplicas=1, maxReplicas=12. KEDA scaledObject has no minReplicaOverride here. Model startup time observed ~18s (model artifact fetch + init). readinessProbe is only 5s which means pod isn't marked ready during the expensive init.
Maya Chen: Repro I ran (short): concurrently POST 25 requests to /v1/generate -> queue grows, no new pods for ~60-90s, gateway 504s. Model logs show model-init ~18s then readiness passing.
Priya Shah: Customer is on Gold SLA and wants immediate mitigation. They also flagged billing anomalies due to retries. Can we fail to a smaller model for low-latency responses?
Gabe Lin: Quick mitigation plan: 1) lower KEDA activationThreshold for this pool to ~40-50, 2) bump HPA minReplicas to 2-3 for tenant-heavy pools, 3) change readinessProbe to probe a lightweight /healthz that returns ready only after model is warmed OR increase probe timeout. Manual scale to buy time.
Maya Chen: Manual scale executed: `kubectl scale deploy model-prod-acmepay --replicas=3` — done. Monitoring for error-rate.
OpsBot: kubectl: scaled deployment/model-prod-acmepay to 3 replicas.
Priya Shah: Customer reports some successful requests now but still intermittent 504s. Probably because new pods are warming caches.
Jamal Rivera: Long-term: add prewarm hook on scale up to fetch model shards & warm KV cache. Also consider prefix caching for common prompts from this customer.
Victor Ng: I'll open infra PR to change the scaledObject activationThreshold and HPA defaults. Will do a canary rollout across a few tenants first.
Maya Chen: Created support ticket INC-2024-3456 and started collecting logs/traces for postmortem. If error-rate not <2% in 15m I'll escalate to Eng.
Priya Shah: I'll update AcmePay with current mitigations and an ETA (~1h) for a patch. Confirming owners: Victor (infra PR), Gabe (runtime prewarm + probe changes), Jamal (operator runbook + playbook steps), Maya (incident timeline + logs), Priya (customer comms).
Gabe Lin: Postmortem notes draft: root cause = KEDA activationThreshold misaligned with actual queue metrics + readinessProbe too conservative for long model init -> pods not ready while traffic queued -> gateway timeout. Mitigations: lower activation threshold, bump minReplicas for hot-tenants, implement prewarm on scale, add fallback to smaller model, improve observability (per-tenant warmup latency metric).
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: I'll attach timelines and logs to INC-2024-3456. Keeping this thread updated. If anyone runs commands, paste them here.
Priya Shah: Thanks all. I'll send customer update now and mark incident active. Closing when SLO stabilizes and PR is merged.
